title.narrative: Urgent medical response to provide relief to those affected by the earthquake in Syria

description.narrative: Alleviating the suffering of the Syrians affected by the earthquake by providing a diverse medical response to save lives, and assisting those afflicted as a result of the earthquake by providing primary health care services and community and nutritional awareness to those affected in a number of Syrian regions

These facilities are able to continue to provide medical services and surgical operations urgently for those injured in the earthquake / and to provide the necessary health services in light of the large number of injured people who cannot move to hospitals and health and nutritional care services for the displaced / for every child to receive his full needs of milk per month

Urgent medical support is divided into three sections, which are supporting 20 hospitals and health facilities with surgical kits of all kinds and medicines / operating a mobile clinic system consisting of mobile field medical teams / securing and distributing infant formula to the groups affected by the earthquake.
